create_onehotcategorical_from_probs: create a OneHotCategorical distribution from probability values using the probs parameter
sample_onehotcategorical_distribution: sample one-hot encoded vectors from a OneHotCategorical distribution with a given seed and sample shape
compute_log_prob_onehotcategorical: compute the log probability of one-hot encoded values against a OneHotCategorical distribution
compute_kl_divergence_categorical: compute KL divergence between a Categorical and OneHotCategorical distribution using kl_divergence
slice_onehotcategorical_distribution: slice a OneHotCategorical distribution by batch index to get a subset of the distribution
